# test_interleave.py
import pytest

# Replace `your_module` with the module where `interleave` is defined.
from your_module import interleave


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "a,b,expected",
    [
        pytest.param(
            [1, 2, 3],
            ["a", "b", "c"],
            [1, "a", 2, "b", 3, "c"],
            id="same-length",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [1, 2, 3, 4],
            ["a", "b"],
            [1, "a", 2, "b", 3, 4],
            id="first-list-longer",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [1],
            ["a", "b", "c"],
            [1, "a", "b", "c"],
            id="second-list-longer",
        ),
        pytest.param([], [], [], id="both-empty"),
        pytest.param([1, 2], [], [1, 2], id="second-empty"),
        pytest.param([], ["a", "b"], ["a", "b"], id="first-empty"),
        pytest.param(
            [1, 0],
            ["x"],
            [1, "x", 0],
            id="first-longer-with-falsy-tail",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [1],
            ["x", 0],
            [1, "x", 0],
            id="second-longer-with-falsy-tail",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [None, False, 0],
            ["", [], {}],
            [None, "", False, [], 0, {}],
            id="mixed-falsy-values",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            [[1], [2]],
            [[3], [4]],
            [[1], [3], [2], [4]],
            id="nested-lists",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_interleave_returns_expected_result(a, b, expected):
    assert interleave(a, b) == expected


def test_interleave_returns_new_list_and_does_not_mutate_inputs():
    a = [1, 2, 3]
    b = ["x", "y"]

    original_a = a.copy()
    original_b = b.copy()

    result = interleave(a, b)

    assert result == [1, "x", 2, "y", 3]
    assert result is not a
    assert result is not b
    assert a == original_a
    assert b == original_b


def test_interleave_preserves_element_identity():
    left_obj = object()
    right_obj = []

    result = interleave([left_obj], [right_obj])

    assert result[0] is left_obj
    assert result[1] is right_obj


def test_interleave_same_list_passed_twice():
    data = [1, 2, 3]

    assert interleave(data, data) == [1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "a,b",
    [
        pytest.param(None, [], id="a-is-none"),
        pytest.param([], None, id="b-is-none"),
        pytest.param(123, [], id="a-is-non-iterable"),
        pytest.param([], 123, id="b-is-non-iterable"),
        pytest.param((x for x in [1, 2]), ["a"], id="a-is-generator"),
        pytest.param([1], (x for x in ["a"]), id="b-is-generator"),
    ],
)
def test_interleave_invalid_inputs_raise_type_error(a, b):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        interleave(a, b)
